with source as (
    select * from {{ source('jaffle_shop', 'raw_orders') }}
)
select
    id as order_id,
    user_id as customer_id,
    order_date,
    status
from source
caption: One source CTE, one flat rename-only select — no joins.

code:

)
select

    order_id,
    payment_method,
    amount
from source
caption: Same shape as customers and orders — consistent on purpose.
